EXPLORER / 07© OpenStreetMap contributors
IIST CAMPUS · VERSION 7

Built from the map.

This version uses campus corrections supplied on 30 October 2026: named hostels, separate SAC, OAT and Multipurpose Hall, covered walks, steps, lower and upper terraces, deep ponds and sloping roads.

Tar roads have grass verges and shade trees. The central hostel area has bamboo; the roundabout has a garden and high-mast light. Heights in metres, boundary details and building outlines remain approximate. Ardra is building 14; Arundhathy is building 18. The water tank stands on a four-pillar concrete tower on the Phalguni terrace. Building entrances use red pillars and cream canopies inspired by the supplied photo, with clear approach paths. SAC, OAT and MPH connect through OAT; the extra road behind MPH has been removed. Front and back gates include illustrative CISF officers. No building interiors are included.

Guide the chibi girl with WASD or arrow keys. Hold Shift to run and press Space to jump. The camera follows her; move the mouse or drag to rotate it, and scroll to change its distance. Click the scene to capture the mouse, or drag to look when capture is unavailable. Press V for an aerial view. On touch screens, use the thumb pad, Run and Jump buttons, and drag the scene. Tap Map to choose a destination. Graphics Auto selects a lighter setting for phones and reduces detail if frame rates are low; you can also select Light, Balanced or High.

The optional discovery trail visits five existing landmarks. Follow the gold marker, then press E or tap Discover nearby. Distances are straight-line guidance; follow the campus paths. Progress saves locally in this browser without an account. Press Esc to pause; use the pause menu to restart the trail. The minimap shows your position and the current trail destination. Use “Go to a place” to travel quickly. Campus layout coverage is limited to the supplied map.
